name: Snoh Aalegra
notes: The lane's cinematic-sample wing, No I.D.-mentored. The harmonic parameter is inherited rather than written: "the chord bed is a looped 2-to-4-bar fragment of a 60s/70s soul or film-score record, so expect 7ths, 9ths and unresolved changes she did not write, plus a live string overdub tracking it" — which is why no progression families are authored at all, `maxChords` drops to 3 and the harmonic rhythm vamps: the loop does not cadence. Drums are "sampled-loop grammar over a live-feel top — a filtered break or a soft programmed kick on 1 and the 16th before 3, a low clap/snare on 2&4, sparse hats, and hand percussion. Reverb is long and the drums sit behind the strings", so the snare is layered and quiet, the hat is non-continuous at a fill density of 0.22, and the percussion gain is cut. This is one of the seven models in this section that carries an 808: the entry says "sub-808 or filtered sample bass with a long decay under the loop; occasional played bass. Slides are rare, so the low end reads as sustained rather than gliding" — so `drums.bass808` is authored with role **counter_riff**, a slide probability of 0.03 and `lowPassed`, which keeps the sub while leaving the played-bass generator alive; role `bassline` would have silenced it. The bassline itself is `mirror_kick` for the same reason. ⛔ **Two parts is only true if they are two lines, and until `kick.lockTo808` was authored they were one.** The value arrives as 1 from `_defaults`, so the sub took every kick tick and `mirror_kick` took the same ticks off the same lane — `coherence::the_low_end_is_played_by_one_part_or_the_other` measured a share of 1.00 at seed 6. 0.5 is the entry's own description of the sub rather than a number chosen to clear a gate: *"a long decay under the loop"* and *"the low end reads as sustained rather than gliding"* is a sub that does NOT re-articulate on each of a 3-to-5-per-bar kick, and because the lane is `legato` every note it does play rings to the next one — half the onsets is twice the decay. ⚠ **INFERRED:** 0.5 exactly, like every other 808 number here. Melody is "smooth mid-alto, low-to-moderate note-density, long legato phrases, breathy at the top, with wide airy stacks on the hook and a spoken/whispered ad-lib layer". ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are all drum and 808 numbers and every melody figure; the research marks tempo and drum values as inference and [LOW-CONF]. ⚠ The half-time subset is not encoded. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“sub-808 or filtered sample bass with a long decay under the loop; occasional played bass. Slides are rare, so the low end reads as sustained rather than gliding.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 978/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.18 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "strings, horns and Rhodes inherited from the sample plus live overdubs; the palette is deliberately widescreen. Melody is smooth mid-alto, low-to-moderate note-density, long legato phrases, breathy at the top, with wide airy stacks on the hook and a spoken/whispered ad-lib layer.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
